description: Fig. 4 - TTFT (p50, seconds) vs. padded prompt length for Qwen3-32B on RTX 3090 at the auto-selected cpu(43u)+cuda(23u) partition (embedding plus first 42 of 64 transformer blocks on CPU), 32 CPU threads, n=5 per point.
claim: TTFT scales 20.8x over the 32x input-length range: prefill on a heavy CPU partition grows with prompt length, not flat.
